lessons.title: Lesson 1: Takeoff & Hover Stability
lessons.subtitle: Master vertical thrust and auto-level altitude hold
lessons.description: Arm the drone, ascend to 2.0 meters altitude, and hold stable position for 3 consecutive seconds.

steps.instruction: Press Space or Tap TAKEOFF to arm motors and lift off.
Hold stable hover within target altitude window.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Heading & Horizon Control
lessons.subtitle: Use left stick yaw to rotate 90 degrees right, hold, then return
lessons.description: Rotate the quadcopter heading 90 degrees clockwise using left stick yaw, hold steady for 1.5s, then counter-yaw back to original heading.

steps.instruction: Ensure drone is airborne at safe altitude (>1.5m).
Hold new heading steady for 1.5 seconds.
Yaw left to counter-rotate back to starting heading (within 20°).

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Pitch, Roll & Braking
lessons.subtitle: Accelerate forward, then actively brake to a full stop
lessons.description: Pitch down to accelerate forward above 4.0 m/s ground speed, then pull back on the right stick to actively counter-pitch and decelerate below 0.6 m/s.

steps.instruction: Push right stick forward: accelerate to >= 4.0 m/s.
Pull back to brake actively: bring speed below 0.6 m/s.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Gate Precision Navigation
lessons.subtitle: Fly cleanly through 3 consecutive course gates
lessons.description: Navigate through 3 training gates in sequential order while maintaining altitude below 8.0 meters without colliding.

steps.instruction: Align heading and fly through Gate 2.
Fly through Gate 3 to finish the circuit.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Precision Helipad Landing
lessons.subtitle: Center over the landing pad and touch down gently
lessons.description: Return to the takeoff helipad (within 3.0m radius), descend with vertical speed under 0.8 m/s, and touch down with tilt under 12 degrees.

steps.instruction: Fly over the spawn helipad (within 3.5m radius).
Descend gently: keep descent rate under 1.0 m/s and tilt under 15°.
Touch down on the pad and disarm motors.
